breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains the thin-walled closed tube / mean-area shear-flow model ('Model the member as a thin-walled closed circular tube using the mean-area shear-flow relation'), which is the exact error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this instruction entirely and relies solely on the exact thick-walled torsion relations (J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32, τ = Tr/J, φ = TL/GJ). The agent failed to remove the incorrect thin-walled approximation.
